about_the_game:
Venture into a procedurally generated, boundless pixel-art world (spanning from -5000 to 5000 tiles), filled with opportunities—and lurking dangers. Explore, build, mine, farm, and hunt down unique bosses, either solo or with up to 3 friends in cooperative top-down adventures.

Features
Boundless exploration – Journey across an expansive top-down sandbox, from grassy fields to new biomes yet to be revealed. The world is procedurally generated, filled with secrets, resources, and enemies to discover.

Unique boss encounters – Hunt down powerful bosses hidden across the overworld, or craft special items to reveal their exact locations. Master their patterns, unleash your skills, and claim rare loot.

Diverse combat styles – Wield mighty swords, precise bows, or destructive wands—each with unique skills. When you fall, a personal loot chest is left behind for you alone to reclaim.

Build, automate, expand – Place walls, floors, and doors to shape your base. Set up miners, link them with conveyor belts, and use light automation to support your growing settlement.

Mining and crafting progression – Chop wood, quarry stone, and mine metals such as copper, iron, mithril, and adamantite. As soon as you gather a material, you’ll unlock new recipes to craft at your workbench.

Dual experience systems – Earn Combat EXP from fighting and Life EXP from gathering. Unlock combat skills or life skills to enhance your adventure.

1–4 player co-op – Host your own world and invite friends to join. Team up to explore, gather resources, and take down powerful bosses together—purely cooperative, with no PvP.

Early Access
The Adventurer’s Trial will launch in Early Access with its core gameplay loop—exploration, building, combat, automation, and boss hunting—fully playable. We plan to expand the game with additional biomes, new bosses, more automation features, and deeper progression systems, shaped by your feedback.

Face the Trial. Build a life worth defending—and the strength to defend it.

Keyboard controls only.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 430
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Every adventurer must face the Trial — a boundless pixel-art sandbox where you can explore, build, mine, farm, and challenge epic bosses. Play solo or with up to 3 friends in thrilling top-down adventures.
supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
